observations: body L2: the letters of the figures, «اب», «ج د» and «ب ج», are printed with a line over them.

body L9, L12, L13, L18, L19, L21, L22, L30: «ثلثة» (L9), «درجةً» (L12), «ستّة» (L13, the first), «ساعة» (L18), «وثُمْن» (L19), «مطالع» (L21), «مطلع» (L22, the first) and «هذا» (L30, the second) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
